newsitem.title: UK: Did Dodi do a dirty on Di?.
newsitem.headline: Did Dodi do a dirty on Di?.

text.p: British tabloids branded Dodi Fayed a two-timer on Friday after an American model said the jet-setting film producer was engaged to her when he was romancing Princess Diana at sea.
"You're a Dodi rotten cheat," said the Mirror's front-page headline.

The best-selling Sun, under the headline "Dodi two timed me with Diana", said Kelly Fisher's story was the "royal sensation to end them all". Even the highbrow Times gave over its front page to Fisher and the dazzling engagement ring she says Dodi gave her.
A spokesman for the Al Fayeds was quoted as saying that Dodi knew Fisher but had never been engaged to her.

Friends of the family went further. One told Reuters on condition of anonymity. "Dodi knows the girl. Dodi gives girls presents. But I'm advised that he was never engaged to her -- and he's not engaged to the princess either."
Fisher, a 31-year-old blonde with more than a passing resemblAnce to Diana, catapulted to fame overnight by launching a lawsuit against Dodi for breach of contract.

At a news conference in Los Angeles, Fisher's lawyer claimed the Vogue model was emotionally "left at the altar" when fuzzy photographs were published on Sunday showing Dodi and Diana embracing on board a luxury yacht.
While Diana relaxed at sea, Dodi was spending time, by day and by night, on a neighbouring boat with his fiancee Fisher, said her celebrity lawyer Gloria Allred.
She said Fisher only realised her wedding was off when she saw the intimate Dodi and Diana photos.
Dodi, whose Egyptian father Mohamed Al Fayed owns Harrods department store in London, was himself an unknown until news broke of his romance with Diana.
Now his past is public property as questions are asked about the mother of a future British king dating a man with a taste for gorgeous women -- and lots of them.
It was far from clear what impact Fisher's tale of betrayal would have on Diana, who as usual kicked off the day with a trip to the gym and a brushoff to reporters.
Buckingham Palace declined all comment.
True or not, Fisher's story represents another setback in 36-year-old Diana's chequered love life.
Betrayed for an older woman in her marriage to Prince Charles, Diana was linked to a series of unsuitable men before Dodi swept her away to the Mediterranean.
On Thursday night, the 41-year-old film producer was reported to have spent the evening engaged in long conversation with Diana as Fisher dropped her bombshell.

"Sobbing Kelly's story spells end of Di affair," said the Sun. But it went on to quote a friend of Diana as saying the princess was braced for skeletons to tumble out of Dodi's cupboard and would not give him up easily.
"She knew all along she'd be entering choppy waters," said the friend. "I would be very surprised if she gave up on the relationship. If anything it will make her more determined."
The Evening Standard concurred, quoting Al Fayed as telling friends that his son and Diana continue to talk marriage and that Dodi wants her to convert to Islam.
For her part, Diana has been quoted as saying she didn't get out of one bad marriage to rush into another -- but has not ruled out having a go at a happy one.
